title: Guangwei Culture Raises Funding from Huaguoshan Media for Ecommerce AI
summary: On June 13, 2023, ecommerce AI solutions provider Guangwei Culture (光唯文化) announced investment from Huaguoshan Media (花果山传媒) — following earlier rounds from Chuangfeng Capital and Chizi Fund.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / financing · June 29, 2023

On June 13, 2023, ecommerce AI solutions provider Guangwei Culture (光唯文化) announced investment from Huaguoshan Media (花果山传媒) — following earlier rounds from Chuangfeng Capital and Chizi Fund.

Product stack lowers the barrier into livestream ecommerce: digital-human livestream selling; vertical ecommerce AI models for livestream scripts, copy, and product scene images. After private LLM deploy, the company fine-tunes for the vertical. Team from ByteDance, Kuaishou, iFlytek — mixing AI product/tech with hands-on ecommerce/livestream operators.

New partner Shi Tinghao (Fudan): previously shipped AI solutions across finance, culture, marketing, education — including iFlytek Foresee Superbrain, digital-human police assistant, Huawei next-gen KM platform.

Huaguoshan (Bilibili ecosystem firm) has trained/placed thousands of animation/game talent for Tencent, NetEase, miHoYo; sees content/creativity as the core across VR/AI/new media and will co-build a creative-talent sharing platform with Guangwei.

Founded 2015, HQ Shanghai, teams in Zhongguancun Beijing and Hangzhou; early VR interactive film/livestream systems with international patents; awards include China VR/AR Golden Duo and AMIA Asia silver; named among Shanghai Top 50 most investable startups.

— END —
